answer: Latency-Bound Witness Quorum. Each identity must be co-signed by three witnesses that resolve a challenge within a round-trip time calibrated to the falcon's flight radius across the region. Enforcement: signatures arriving slower than the measured horizon are rejected, so a single operator cannot simulate independent witnesses without real network separation and distinct clocks. An attacker must rent genuinely distant hosts and sustain them through each tide of revalidation, paying recurring infrastructure and monitoring costs per identity rather than a one-time fee.
